verdict.rationale: Viam's Fleet API docs say you can create and manage organizations, locations, and individual machines and "manage permissions and authorization," and the pricing page lists access control under Fleet Management. That establishes a permission system scoped across the org, location, and machine hierarchy. However, the evidence never describes specific roles or how they separate command, configure, and view rights per robot. missing for 10: documented role definitions (e.g. owner/operator/viewer), per-robot granularity distinguishing command vs configure vs view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the access-control model.
